title: Book One · Chapter 128: The Blue Thread
story:
Mum has a new piece of blue cloth on her lap. Ronan remembers the blue cloth in the shop window. Is Mum making her dress? He looks again. This piece is too small.

“It is for a bag,” she says.

“For you?”

“This first one is for me. If it works well, I may make a few to sell.”

She puts a folded book inside the cloth. The book makes the bottom stand out.

“A book bag?”

“For books, clothes, vegetables. Things people carry.”

Ronan puts his finger near the edge. Mum moves the needle away.

“You can hold the far end.”

He holds it. She shows him the two handles. One is longer than the other. She must take out a line of thread.

“You made it wrong.”

“I did.”

“Does that happen often?”

“Often enough to keep this little tool busy.”

She lifts her small sewing tool. She uses it to take out old stitches. Ronan watches her pull out the blue thread. She pulls a short bit each time.

“Could you leave it?”

“Then the bag would hang badly.”

“Could I have the long handle?”

“It is still my bag.”

He laughs and lets go of the cloth. Mum takes out the last stitch. She lays the handles flat, measures them again, and begins a new line.

In the yard Mr Qiu is packing his notebooks. Mrs Lan's sister has finished her visit. The front room is clear now. Mr Qiu still uses the high shelf at night. Dad checked it before the boxes went there. “This way works well,” Mum says. “We can keep using it.”

Ronan brings out his street drawing. He has room at the bottom for another person. He begins to draw Mum in the kitchen.

She looks over.

“What am I doing?”

“Sewing.”

“May I see?”

He gives her the page. She studies the little round head and the long dark hair.

“That is a fine nose.”

“It is your real nose.”

“Then I am pleased with it.”

He wants to write MUM under the picture. She taps the empty space.

“For our wall, Mum is fine. If other people see it, I have my own name.”

Ronan has heard her name many times. He has never needed it on his drawings. He gets a clean strip of paper and asks her to write it herself.

Mum finds a strip of blue cloth too. She folds its rough edges under. She points to a place for a name. This strip could go inside a bag.

“Would every bag need your whole name?” he asks.

“Perhaps a small mark. I have not chosen one yet.”

Ronan draws a bell on the paper. Mum looks at it and shakes her head.

“That is your thing. I will choose mine.”

He puts a line around his bell and keeps it for another drawing. Her strip of cloth stays plain beside the needle.

She writes her name in Chinese. Ronan sets the strip under the drawing. Before, he only wrote MUM on his pictures. Now other people can read her name. They can see her sewing the blue bag too.

“May this go at school too?”

“Show me the words first.”

He has not written any yet. He sits down and begins with the blue bag. Mum sews beside him. When he looks up again, both handles are the same length. He looks at the loose blue thread on the table. Mum has taken it out and sewn again. Now the bag stands with both handles together.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：thread＝线；stitch＝针脚；same length＝相同长度。

情节提示：needle＝缝衣针；rough＝不平整的；Chinese＝中文。

理解：1. Mum 为什么拆掉一排线？2. 她希望公开的画怎样标明自己？
